say:0:1560209001:0.text: I'm sure it's just unlucky timing, Magister!
say:0:1560209001:0.source_cn: 运气不好而已！对主人来说，这都是小菜一碟！
say:0:1560209001:0.male: I'm sure it's just unlucky timing, Magister!
say:0:1560209001:0.female: I'm sure it's just unlucky timing, Magister!

say:1:1560209002:0.text: Yeah! Chippy will help Magister beat them up!
say:1:1560209002:0.source_cn: 就是！就是！再来一次肯定把它们都打趴下！

say:2:1560209003:0.text: But the poison fog is blocking our way back...
say:2:1560209003:0.source_cn: 只可惜……那里已经充满了毒雾，我们回不去了。

say:3:1560209004:0.text: Let's move on. We have bigger problems up ahead.
say:3:1560209004:0.source_cn: 我们还有更重要的事要做，先走吧，回头再说。
say:3:1560209004:0.male: Let's move on. We have bigger problems up ahead.
say:3:1560209004:0.female: Let's move on. We have bigger problems up ahead.
